title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 140
paragraphs: Such were the events of that time. Many years later, after the Chersonese on the Hellespont had come under the Athenians, Miltiades son of Cimon, while the Etesian winds were blowing steadily, made the voyage in a single ship from Elaius in the Chersonese to Lemnos and ordered the Pelasgians to leave the island, reminding them of the oracle they had never expected to see fulfilled. The people of Hephaestia obeyed; but those of Myrina, not acknowledging that the Chersonese was Attica, endured a siege, until in the end they too submitted. That is how the Athenians, under Miltiades, took possession of Lemnos.
